bonuses.title: VIP rank-up rewards
bonuses.headline: $20 – $500K
bonuses.subCopy: Cash paid at each new rank, from $20 at Bronze 1 to $500,000 at Onyx. Rakeback and the monthly bonus start from Starter; the weekly bonus from Bronze 1.

bonuses.title: Daily reload & VIP host
bonuses.headline: Gold 1
bonuses.subCopy: Daily reload from Gold 1, based on your last 7 days of play; a dedicated VIP host from Gold 4; birthday bonus from Platinum for verified profiles.
bonuses.sourceNote: Razed's own in-account VIP page, screenshot-verified — razed.com blocks automated fetches

bonuses.title: Milestone prizes
bonuses.headline: Lamborghini
bonuses.subCopy: The first player to reach each top rank wins a prize — a Mercedes G-Wagon at Red Diamond, a Lamborghini Huracán STO at Blue Diamond and a Revuelto at Onyx. Lower-rank prizes are already claimed.
bonuses.sourceNote: Razed's own in-account VIP page, screenshot-verified — razed.com blocks automated fetches

bonuses.title: VIP transfer
bonuses.headline: Bronze 1 – Diamond
bonuses.subCopy: Bring a VIP rank from another casino through live support, with proof of status. The rank unlocks permanently once you hit set deposit and wager targets. One per person and household.

bonuses.title: 5% Rakeback
bonuses.subCopy: Rakeback on every bet, claimable every 30 minutes — half paid straight to your balance, half added to the Rewards Calendar over 3 days. Each calendar claim adds an hour of +15% Rakeboost.

bonuses.title: Daily, weekly & monthly bonuses
bonuses.headline: 3 recurring
bonuses.subCopy: Personalised on your wagering and profit and loss, with lossback in the weekly and monthly. 20% is paid immediately; the rest drips through the calendar over 7, 7 and 30 days.

bonuses.title: $25K Daily Race
bonuses.subCopy: Daily wager race paying the top places, from $10,000 for 1st down to $300 for 10th.
bonuses.sourceNote: Rollbit's own race page, screenshot-verified — rollbit.com blocks automated fetches

bonuses.title: Welcome bonus
bonuses.headline: 5,000 USDT
bonuses.subCopy: Across the first three deposits: 100% up to 1,000 USDT, then 50% up to 2,000, then 100% up to 2,000. Live dealer and table games don't count.

bonuses.title: 10% Weekly Cashback
bonuses.subCopy: Paid automatically every Thursday around 13:00 UTC; higher VIP levels raise the share. Sportsbook and live dealer bets excluded.

bonuses.title: Weekly Raffle
bonuses.subCopy: Tickets earned by wagering; 20 winning tickets pay $100 each. Betplay also runs a $1,000 Weekly Race.
